win_system.notes:
WAYS TO WIN

 The specified requirements for a winning combination in the base game are also used during bonus features or free spins play unless otherwise stated. Each wager is eligible for all winning combinations unless otherwise stated.

 You win if matching symbols appear along one of the following predefined lines on adjacent reels from left to right, starting with the leftmost reel. The number of possible lines in this game is 35. Please consult the paytable for the number of each symbol

respins.how_it_works:
Land the Switch scatter symbol to activate SwitchSpins™. SwitchSpins™ are a special type of respins where selected symbols are replaced with either the highest paying symbol in the game or wild symbols. The feature can award 1-10 respins. Landing a new Switch symbol during the feature will add more symbols to be replaced and award additional respins.

 The replacing symbol and the remaining number of SwitchSpins™ in the current set is shown on the top right corner of the grid. The symbols that will be replaced are shown in the center above the grid.

 After the current set of SwitchSpins™ have ended, the selected replaced symbols are reset.

 If a bonus game is triggered while SwitchSpins™ are active, the current set of SwitchSpins™ will finish before entering the bonus game.

 After the current set of SwitchSpins™ have ended, the selected replaced symbols are reset.

 If a bonus game is triggered while SwitchSpins™ are active, the current set of SwitchSpins™ will finish before entering the bonus game.

wilds.name: TOTAL TAKEOVER
wilds.behavior:
Land 3 Total Takeover scatter symbols at the same time in the base game or in Mad Scientist bonus game to trigger the Total Takeover bonus game, which awards 10 free spins!

 In this bonus there is a higher chance of landing the Switch symbol to trigger the SwitchSpins™ feature than the base game, and all selected symbols to be replaced are saved progressively, meaning they do not reset after each SwitchSpins™ set is completed. Collect them all to fill the screen completely with the highest paying or wild symbol!

 Landing 3 Total Takeover symbols at the same time in the feature awards 4 additional free spins.

 SPECIAL SYMBOLS

 The Wild symbol substitutes for all symbols in the paytable.

scatters.name: MAD SCIENTIST
scatters.behavior:
Land 3 Mad Scientist scatter symbols at the same time in the base game to trigger Mad Scientist bonus game, which awards 10 free spins!

 In this bonus there is a higher chance of landing the Switch symbol to trigger the SwitchSpins™ feature than the base game!

 Landing 3 Total Takeover scatter symbols at the same time in the feature triggers the Total Takeover bonus game at the end of the current spin and resets the number of remaining free spins to 10 spins.

 The world as we knew it is no more! The zombie apocalypse is here, and the only way to survive this new reality is to watch out for all the undead and stay away from the mad scientist who created them! Rotten is a 6x5 grid game with paylines, the SwitchSpins™ mechanic, two bonus games and a max win of 10,000x!

 The max win can be achieved in the base game, Mad Scientist and Total Takeover game modes.
